leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a scheduled cleanup task using Node.js cron jobs
Implement file system operations to identify and remove outdated data files
Configure retention policies based on file age and naming patterns
Initialize logging mechanisms to track cleanup task execution and errors
Integrate environment variables to customize retention periods and file paths
Manipulate directory structures to safely archive or delete expired data
Apply error handling to manage file permission issues and missing directories
